name: Reel Marks
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: SHIFT + TAP marks a moment worth a clip; a Mac script cuts the clips for reels.
description: Press SHIFT + TAP (the Beat FX TAP button) during a set to mark a moment. Each mark saves the time, the minutes into the set and every loaded deck's track, position and BPM to MODS/community-mods/reel-marks/data/marks-<date>.csv on the USB, and shows a short banner. On the Mac, tools/reel_cut.py cuts a clip around each mark from your phone video or recording. SHIFT + TAP never reaches the deck; TAP alone works as usual. Writes only its own file on the USB.
